column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a check whose producer outruns grep -q, the match on its first line, is done
a pipeline whose first stage fails and whose last succeeds is done, as in a probe
a when naming an unset variable is unknown, not not-applicable
a when of that shape makes its row applicable, and the check decides it
a when that does not parse is unknown
a when that exits 3 is unknown
a when that replaces its shell with false is unknown
a when that returns 130 is unknown
a when that returns 2 is unknown
a when that returns 3 is unknown
a when that writes returned to its descriptors 1 to 9 and then exits 1 is still unknown
a when whose ${x:?} fails is unknown
a when whose engine function ends the shell is unknown
a when whose own function reads an unset variable is unknown
a when written as exit 1 is unknown, because bash's own fatal errors end the shell with 1
an ask told a variable name sets it to returned when the text came back with 3
an ask told a variable reads no stdin from its caller
an ask whose answer line comes back garbled says unasked, with 2
an engine function that is the whole check runs without pipefail, as the row does
an unterminated case in a when is unknown

and an engine function that fails there reads held

and it names the 130

and it says the shell ended with status 1
and it says the shell ended with status 3

and it says the shell ended, not that a command is missing
and it says the when does not parse
and it says the when ended the shell, with the status it ended with
and it too says the when does not parse
and no part of a when that does not parse was run
and one named in a when
and prints nothing of the text's stderr
and reads the seeded gate_shown_failing row done over that mistakes.log
and returns a text's 3 as 3
and returns a text's own exit 4 as 4
and says its answer could not be read
and so does one inside a command substitution
and to ended when an engine function the text names ends the shell
and to ended when an unset variable ends the shell, with its status
and to ended when the text exits 0, with 0
and to ended when the text exits 4, with 4
